|game_text=Power +2 while armed with a lightsaber. May use any 'stolen' lightsaber. Once during battle, where present, may steal an opponent's just-lost lightsaber. Immune to attrition < 3 (< 5 while armed with a 'stolen' lightsaber).
|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E3 of [[Anakin Solo]] (version 4 of 4); it is the current text. The image here is the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-L-anakinsolo-pre.gif]]). Each version below is quoted in full with its dated source; differences that come only from a document's medium (icons written out in words on the card list, straight quotes, credit lines) are not changes. How these versions came about (Holotable data, the PC website card list, the Master List and the PC card images) is told in [[PC Legacy Virtual Transcription Error History]].
* '''Original''' ([[Anakin Solo]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 8.2 release sheet (official text as of 14 September 2012)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock8_2">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_2.pdf#page=3 Virtual Block 8.2 release sheet] ("Official text as of September 14, 2012"; the surviving copy was re-made 18 October 2012), page 3, slip 12 (position on the sheet; the slip prints no number). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095520/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_2.pdf#page=3 Internet Archive]</ref>: “Power +2 while armed with a lightsaber. May use any 'stolen' lightsaber. Once per turn, where present, may steal an opponent's just-lost lightsaber. Immune to attrition < 3 (< 5 while armed with a 'stolen' lightsaber).” The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB8-02-Anakin_Solo.png]]) prints it. The release-sheet slip prints no slip number.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Anakin Solo (Errata)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 12 December 2012 and in the capture of 11 January 2013) changed “Once per turn” to “Once during battle” and printed “<3 (<5”<ref name="cl-1282_12-2012-12-12">Players Committee website card list (VBlock8Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212003733/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2012-12-12] (Internet Archive); the same text in the capture of 11 January 2013 (the card is not in the capture of 21 July 2012)</ref>: “Power +2 while armed with a lightsaber. May use any 'stolen' lightsaber. Once during battle, where present, may steal an opponent's just-lost lightsaber. Immune to attrition <3 (<5 while armed with a 'stolen' lightsaber).” The card list is a text page: no slip, picture or slip number, and icons are written out in words.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Anakin Solo (Errata 2)]]): The Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Light Side, p. 3)<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=3, page 3. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=3 Internet Archive]</ref> prints the original printed text again, word for word: “Power +2 while armed with a lightsaber. May use any 'stolen' lightsaber. Once per turn, where present, may steal an opponent's just-lost lightsaber. Immune to attrition < 3 (< 5 while armed with a 'stolen' lightsaber).” '''What changed:''' “Once per turn” again, for the card list's “Once during battle”, and the spaced “< 3 (< 5”. The Master List repeats words published earlier; it is a version of its own because it was published after a different text (Bill, 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat). The PC website card list was generated from the Holotable card data; the Master List went back to the release-sheet words. The Master List slip shows the whole card frame with the picture area left blank; like the slip, it prints no slip number. In GEMP the Master List wording is the version 2282_2012, which plays as the original.
* '''PC-E3''' (this page): The Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-L-anakinsolo-pre.gif]]) prints: “Power +2 while armed with a lightsaber. May use any 'stolen' lightsaber. Once during battle, where present, may steal an opponent's just-lost lightsaber. Immune to attrition < 3 (< 5 while armed with a 'stolen' lightsaber).” '''What changed:''' The card-list words return: “Once during battle” for “Once per turn”; the image keeps the spaced “< 3 (< 5” of the sheet and the Master List (the card list has “<3 (<5”). The image is undated. The PC's image folder (Virtual8-Light) lists the file, with every other file in it, as last modified on 7 May 2013<ref name="r6-Virtual8-Light">[https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034752/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual8-Light/large/?C=M;O=A Apache directory listing of Virtual8-Light/large] (Internet Archive, captured 18 August 2019): every file in the folder last modified 7 May 2013; the captures of the image in 2018 and 2019 have the same bytes as the file on the wiki. Research note R6, 11 November 2026.</ref>; it is dated by that upload date, after the Master List (27 April 2013), so it is the latest publication and the current text. The date is a bulk upload of the whole Virtual Block 8 folder, and the image may have been made earlier (it prints the superseded card-list words, so it may date from the card list of 2012), but the wiki orders versions by the date each document was published (Bill, 11 November 2026). It is a version of its own even though its words repeat an earlier text (Bill, 11 November 2026: every publication is a version). The card image is the whole card, with the Decipher picture; like the slip, it prints no slip number. GEMP's current card keeps the card-list wording it already played, so nothing changes in play; the Master List wording is a version of its own.
